name: Drift
oneLiner: Conversational marketing and sales chat platform owned by Clari + Salesloft, which announced its gradual sunset in March 2026 and refers existing clients to 1mind.
bestFor: Current Drift customers on the Clari + Salesloft platform planning their move to a successor.

updates.text: Clari + Salesloft announced the gradual sunset of Drift and named 1mind its exclusive AI successor; existing Drift clients are referred to 1mind.
Clari and Salesloft completed their merger; Drift became part of Clari + Salesloft.
Attackers used compromised OAuth tokens from the Salesloft Drift app to reach some customers' Salesforce data; Drift was taken offline and brought back on September 16, 2025.

features: AI chatbots that greet and qualify website visitors
Meeting booking straight into reps' calendars
Routing of high-intent visitors to the right rep or live agent
Account-based targeting for visitors from named accounts
Answers to common questions with handoff to a person

pricing.text: No public pricing. Drift was sold on annual quotes; with the sunset, new purchases are unclear and existing clients are being referred to 1mind.

notes: IMPORTANT: Drift is being sunset (announced March 6, 2026; no published end date). drift.com reportedly redirects to salesloft.com/platform/drift, which says 'We've transitioned from Drift to 1mind'. Reviewer may want to replace this entry in the post. Dropped the original $2,500/month price (third-party estimates only). Salesforce disabled the Drift connection after the August 2025 breach; the breach is not mentioned in the review. Merger date (December 3, 2025) from search summaries; Salesloft newsroom could not be fetched.
